changelog:
- Initial release of the stock-direction-signals skill for MetaMask Agent Wallets.
- Enables one-click, multi-source, paid research briefs on US stocks or index proxies using nine distinct data sources.
- No financial advice or order execution—research-only results with confidence, catalysts, and invalidation risks.
- Runs only with the MetaMask Agent Wallet CLI; requires no SELAT CLI, no keys, and enforces strong spend controls.
- Always requires a dry-run to show live total pricing before any wallet or spending actions.
summary: Directional research brief on a US stock for agents on a MetaMask Agent Wallet — use when asked "is NVDA bullish or bearish right now", "directional read on AAPL", "is MAG7 sentiment turning", "what do the chart, news, and social say about AMD", "signal brief on SPY". Nine paid reads — quote, daily
